standard.summary: 每隔 k 步做一次慢权重同步。
standard.effect: 默认 5（论文推荐）。越大同步越少、越省心但反应越慢；必须 >= 1，否则启动报错。
standard.whenToUse: 一般保持 5。训练极不稳定时可以试更小。
standard.avoidWhen: 设 0 或负数会直接报错拒绝启动。

standard_en.summary: Sync slow weights every k steps.
standard_en.effect: Default 5 (paper recommendation). Larger = fewer syncs, slower reaction; must be >= 1 or startup fails.
standard_en.whenToUse: Keep 5. Try smaller values only for very unstable runs.
standard_en.avoidWhen: 0 or negative fails closed with an error at startup.
